Photography & project scope
Discuss your drawing
01 · LZZ workshop
The component

Front-face holes and a curved side opening place machining features on different faces of this component. Their relationship to a common datum is an important part of planning a similar job.

02 · LZZ workshop
Machining setup

The workpiece is held in front of a rotary assembly, with spindle access from above. Tool reach and clearance around the fixture need to be checked for each face before the machining sequence is confirmed.

Machined features

The accompanying components have machined pockets, contoured edges and repeated hole patterns. These features provide useful reference points when discussing a similar geometry.

Inspection planning

For a comparable project, identify datums, mating features, positional tolerances, surface requirements and the dimensional record you need. LZZ can assess achievable limits and the inspection method from the drawing.
